review_id / user_id are historical identifiers, not FKs.
Audit records survive deletion of the original review.
PK = primary key; FK = enforced foreign key; UQ = single-column UNIQUE. UQ1 marks the two columns in one composite UNIQUE constraint.
NULL is shown explicitly; every other column is NOT NULL. No composite primary keys and no identifying relationships are implemented.
The notes make optional participation explicit; the Chen diagram shows the same design with 1/N labels and participation lines.
